svg.title: CREBAIN steady rotor allocation
svg.desc: A torque plateau can require lower collective thrust to preserve yaw. For zero roll and pitch moments, an 18 N request with yaw 0.05 N·m admits 16.4043 N. The illustration is an analytical steady model. Motor transients and numerical tolerances remain separate.

cc:Work.dc:title: CREBAIN steady rotor allocation
cc:Work.dc:description: Three panels explain capped reaction torque, the collective ceiling at zero roll and pitch, and an 18-newton request with 0.05-newton-meter yaw. This is an analytical steady-model illustration, not simulation measurements.

g.text: Preserve the moments. Reduce collective when required.
At high thrust, the reaction-torque cap can eliminate yaw authority.
Analytical illustration of the explicit one-drone profile. These are steady forces, not measured motor transients.
